text.tspan: People share a meal and conversation.
When we share a meal, a little care can make the experience better. Planning and thinking
First, a simple plan leaves time for conversation. For example, we prepare the vegetables
before our guests arrive. This is a small thing that makes the day easier.
Second, sharing the work helps everyone feel included. For example, each guest brings one
dish and helps clear the table. We do not need a perfect day to do this well.
We can share a meal more easily when we prepare and notice other people. These simple
steps give us a useful place to start.
BUILD YOUR OWN · State a clear main idea; develop two different points with examples; bring them together in the
conclusion. Each body paragraph needs a distinct point and a concrete example. The conclusion should connect the
argument rather than introduce a new proposal.
You want to share a meal, but one thing is difficult. Say what it is and give two ways to help. Use four short paragraphs:
introduction, two developed points, and conclusion. (Model: One possible outline: say what you want to do; explain the first
step; explain a different second step; say why the two steps help.)
